description: This file contains unit tests for the NATS streaming client integration within an Orleans testing environment. It sets up and tears down NATS streams, configures test clusters, and includes a specific test method for stream producer behavior when clients are dropped.

classes.name: NatsClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for NATS client streaming integration with Orleans, including setup, teardown, and specific test methods.

classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use NATS streams and memory storage for testing.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client to connect to NATS streams for testing.

methods.name: NatsClientStreamTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes NATS connection and context, skipping tests if NATS is unavailable.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the NATS stream and connection after each test.
